name: Beta Distribution Prior on Exit Opacity
definition: Regularization term using the negative log-likelihood of a Beta(0.5, 0.5) distribution on final image opacities to reduce entropy, based on the intuition that rays should strike the object or background rather than grazing surfaces.
summary: The Beta Distribution Prior on Exit Opacity is a regularization technique that encourages sharp, solid materials in neural volume rendering by penalizing intermediate opacity values, distinguishing itself from the Entropy prior by better preserving thin structures.
